title: Propagation from a TLE and from its exact OMM twin: seven shipped sets, the corpus's own reference vectors, within 2e-7

checks.description: Each of seven shipped TLE sets (derived/propagation-twins/twins.tle) through the parser's propagate hook at six times (-1 day, -1 hour, 0, +1 hour, +1 day, +7 days): every TEME position and velocity component within 2e-7 km and km/s of the corpus's own reference vectors (vectors/propagation-twins.json: SGP4 by Vallado's C++, WGS-72, opsmode 'i', cross-checked with python-sgp4), every SGP4 error code exact (every reference step propagates, so a false decay is what the codes catch). The TLE is sent as its two element lines (D-406).

The same for each set's OMM CSV twin (derived/propagation-twins/twins.csv), whose values are exactly the TLE's: a library whose OMM path reads the angles, the mean motion, the eccentricity or BSTAR otherwise than its TLE path fails here, and the epoch through the two deep-space sets (100530, 270354) only, since near-earth SGP4 in TEME does not depend on it (D-406).
For each set the parser propagated from both renderings, its TLE and OMM answers within 2e-7 of each other at every step, their codes the same (D-406).

provides: 7 TLE sets and their exact OMM CSV twins, 6 times each, near-earth and deep-space
gaps: OMM CSV only: the other OMM formats' twins are later

seven shipped sets, not the design's 33 SGP4-VER sets (never shipped, D-388) or the 304 provider pairs, whose OMM carries more digits than the TLE and which are to be reported, never graded (lane C's design section 3)
the epoch is graded through the two deep-space sets only; MEAN_MOTION_DOT and MEAN_MOTION_DDOT, which SGP4 does not use, not at all
every reference step propagates: the codes catch a false decay, not a missing error

case_specific.generated_with: tools/sgp4_reference_vectors.cpp built against Vallado's SGP4.cpp at the recipe's pin (harnesses/vallado/README.md), WGS-72, opsmode 'i'
case_specific.cross_check: python-sgp4 2.27 (Satrec, sgp4_tsince, WGS-72): the same error code at every step and within 2e-07 at every step that propagated; largest difference 0
